Where Distance Has No Common Meaning
Universes are not neighboring rooms in a larger space. Near and far belong to each world; their confluence needs no shared map and no journey through the gap.
A law can hold faithfully within one universe and have no meaning in another. Their meeting is not permission to break local rules; it is the absence of one universal rulebook.
Omnielle teaches the fairies to answer a shared motif without measuring a route or synchronized moment. This is a fictional relationship, not a claim of faster-than-light signaling.
Recognition does not select one universe and erase the rest. Worlds remain distinct possibilities held together; no single observer owns their existence.
The fairies prepare Omnielle's foundation: connection without conquest, coexistence without sameness, and care for lives whose worlds may never share a sky.

Omnielle builds a confluence of infinitely many superposed universes. No shared clock, common distance, or single causal law governs their meeting. She shelters their relationships without collapsing their differences; every living world retains its own story.

Serenity: A Place for Every Feeling

Build a dimension of emotional relationship throughout creation. It holds the possibility of understanding, not one compulsory mood or a shared mind. Each heart keeps its freedom; every feeling may be heard.

On planet Earth, humans live through bodies, families, communities, and changing seasons. This fictional saga imagines that a soul might also reside in another realm at the same time; earthly life remains fully real and worthy of care.
One Life, More Than One Presence

In this game's myth, an embodied human may have a soul-presence elsewhere without departing Earth. Two homes can coexist in one life: this is simultaneous presence, not death, reincarnation, or a scientific claim about consciousness.

Imagine a person tending an Earth garden while their soul also resides among the Angel Realm's luminous gardens. Neither presence replaces the other; an angelic connection grants no authority over another person's choices or worth.

Other human stories imagine soul-presences in the Demon, Elves and Fairies, Gods, or Shadow realms, perhaps in more than one at once. No realm determines a human's morality, rank, or destiny, and not every person shares this belief.

A human may interpret dreams, imagination, or quiet reflection as symbols of connection within this story, never as proof of another realm. Food, rest, friendship, and responsibility on Earth remain important; nobody must leave or neglect their body to belong.

Build a dimension that holds Earthly embodiment and possible soul-presences in other realms together. Its bridges represent coexistence rather than escape or compulsory travel. Different beliefs are welcome: no human must claim a soul-home to have a place in creation.
